svg.aria-label: Describe PRs in Chinese and draw only the changed flows
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Describe PRs in Chinese and draw only the changed flows
svg.desc: The PR Lens action now asks the model for the graph itself. pr-lens.mjs reads the PR title and body, streams the model request, and validates the graph. It then decides from the diff whether to draw up to two data flows, one architecture view, or nothing. The comment body is written in Traditional Chinese. Tests and docs no longer earn a picture, and changes under 20 runtime lines get text only. Render, publish, and canvas steps are skipped when nothing is drawn. The upstream CLI analyze step is replaced, and the CLI and schema are pinned to new versions.
